scientific_question: Under one lifecycle-matched local WorldMemArena protocol, how do four executable memory baselines compare on quality, retrieval, memory behavior, efficiency, reliability, and every frozen dataset slice?
claim_boundary: Supports local same-protocol baseline estimates only after every required seed for a method is terminal-accepted and independently aggregated; it does not import official paper scores or establish AgentEnhance superiority.

prerequisite.decision: All four methods use three full seeds because at least two gate semantic digests differ for every method.

fixed_data.atomic_unit: one original sample; units are never resumed or overwritten

execution_plan.scheduling: sequential method-major order on one fixed service stack

model_stack.model_retention: Both snapshots are shared pre-existing assets and must never be deleted by this study.

outcomes.primary_and_guardrail_metrics: all fields and directions in comparisons/wma-main-table-spec.v2.json
outcomes.slice_surface: all 53 frozen slice values per method; no post-result subset selection
outcomes.reliability: n_expected=150, n_observed=150, n_failed=0 is required for admission

statistics.per_method_point_estimate: arithmetic mean of the three seed-level full-split estimates
statistics.seed_variability: sample standard deviation across seeds 0, 1, and 2
statistics.paired_comparison_unit: original sample index with all QA inside that sample kept together
statistics.paired_confidence_interval: two-sided 95 percent percentile cluster bootstrap with 10000 resamples and bootstrap seed 20260903; average metric over the three model seeds before taking paired method differences
statistics.counts: report one benchmark denominator (150 samples and 7906 QA) plus seed_count=3; do not present 450 samples as independent
statistics.multiple_axes: all predeclared axes remain visible; category-best claims name the slice and denominator

admission_rule: A method becomes main-comparison eligible only after all three scheduler roots have 150 accepted and zero rejected units, all three aggregate roots pass independent hashes and denominator checks, and no non-finite metric or missing monitor sample exists.

failure_and_recovery.unit_failure: seal the unit TERMINAL_REJECTED; do not retry in place
failure_and_recovery.seed_failure: seal the scheduler root and stop the Wave-1 controller before the next seed
failure_and_recovery.recovery: write a new diagnosis and prefreeze, then use a fresh controller, seed, and unit root; never overwrite parent evidence
failure_and_recovery.cleanup: stop only project-owned tmux sessions; delete only future run-owned ephemeral model weights after accepted evidence is archived

prohibited_actions: using official paper numbers to fill any local result cell
admitting a partial seed or fewer than three seeds
dropping a method, metric, seed, failed sample, or slice after observing results
selecting a checkpoint or prompt using AgentEnhance outcomes
editing or resuming a terminal run root
deleting shared model snapshots or another user's files or processes
